f3_program: observe(at("jack.barbecue_sauce.ketchup.volume", "initial"), 3, "cup", source("3 cups of ketchup"))
observe(at("jack.barbecue_sauce.vinegar.volume", "initial"), 1, "cup", source("1 cup of vinegar"))
observe(at("jack.barbecue_sauce.honey.volume", "initial"), 1, "cup", source("1 cup of honey"))

sum_relation(at("jack.barbecue_sauce.volume", "initial"), at("jack.barbecue_sauce.ketchup.volume", "initial"), at("jack.barbecue_sauce.vinegar.volume", "initial"), at("jack.barbecue_sauce.honey.volume", "initial"), source("He uses 3 cups of ketchup, 1 cup of vinegar and 1 cup of honey"))
observe(at("jack.pulled_pork_sandwiches.count", "scenario"), 18, "count", source("18 pulled pork sandwiches"))

consume("make_pulled_pork_sandwiches", "jack", at("jack.barbecue_sauce.volume", "current"), fraction(at("jack.pulled_pork_sandwiches.count", "scenario"), 1, 6), source("each pulled pork sandwich takes 1/6 cup, how many burgers can Jack make if he makes 18 pulled pork sandwiches"))
rate_relation(at("jack.barbecue_sauce.volume", "current"), fraction(1, 1, 4), at("jack.burgers.count", "possible"), source("each burger takes 1/4 cup of sauce"))
query("value", at("jack.burgers.count", "possible"))
observe(at("james_and_jordan.oreos.total_count", "current"), 52, "count", source("there are 52 Oreos total"))
sum_relation(at("james_and_jordan.oreos.total_count", "current"), at("james.oreos.count", "current"), at("jordan.oreos.count", "current"), source("there are 52 Oreos total"))
offset(at("james.oreos.count", "current"), scale(at("jordan.oreos.count", "current"), 4), 7, "count", source("James has 7 more than 4 times the number of Oreos Jordan has"))
query("value", at("james.oreos.count", "current"))

observe(at("company.uk_ireland.scope_2.electricity_heat_steam_cooling_purchased_for_own_use", "FY18"), 32389, "tonnes_co2e", cell("Electricity, heat, steam and cooling purchased for own use (Scope 2)", "FY18**"))

observe(at("company.uk_ireland.scope_2.electricity_heat_steam_cooling_purchased_for_own_use", "FY19"), 27633, "tonnes_co2e", cell("Electricity, heat, steam and cooling purchased for own use (Scope 2)", "FY19**"))

query("mean", at("company.uk_ireland.scope_2.electricity_heat_steam_cooling_purchased_for_own_use", "FY18"), at("company.uk_ireland.scope_2.electricity_heat_steam_cooling_purchased_for_own_use", "FY19"))
observe(at("company.liquidity.cash_restricted_cash_and_short_term_marketable_securities", "2019"), 9.0, "billion_usd", cell("Cash, restricted cash and short-term marketable securities", "2019"))
observe(at("company.liquidity.cash_restricted_cash_and_short_term_marketable_securities", "2018"), 12.2, "billion_usd", cell("Cash, restricted cash and short-term marketable securities", "2018"))
observe(at("company.liquidity.cash_restricted_cash_and_short_term_marketable_securities", "2017"), 12.8, "billion_usd", cell("Cash, restricted cash and short-term marketable securities", "2017"))

query("mean", at("company.liquidity.cash_restricted_cash_and_short_term_marketable_securities", "2019"), at("company.liquidity.cash_restricted_cash_and_short_term_marketable_securities", "2018"), at("company.liquidity.cash_restricted_cash_and_short_term_marketable_securities", "2017"))

observe(at("group.adjusted_operating_costs.adjusting_items_total", "2019"), 4.3, "million_usd", source("Before exceptional items, acquisition related costs, acquired intangible asset amortisation and share-based payment amounting to $4.3 million in total (2018 $19.6 million)."))

observe(at("group.adjusted_operating_costs.adjusting_items_total", "2018"), 19.6, "million_usd", source("Before exceptional items, acquisition related costs, acquired intangible asset amortisation and share-based payment amounting to $4.3 million in total (2018 $19.6 million)."))
query("percentage_change", at("group.adjusted_operating_costs.adjusting_items_total", "2018"), at("group.adjusted_operating_costs.adjusting_items_total", "2019"))
assumptions: The requested amounts are the footnote totals for the listed adjusting items rather than the adjusted operating-cost row totals.
